title: Naval Topic 7 生词 · 单词卡

cards.ex: To shortcut something means to find a faster, easier way to do it, skipping some steps. A shortcut is a quicker road.
exs: Is there a way to shortcut this process?
I took a shortcut through the park.

src.t: How do you shortcut that desire contract?

lg: 绕过弯路，抄一条更近的小道。

cards.ex: A desire is a strong feeling of wanting something. Naval says each desire is like a deal you make with yourself.
exs: She has a strong desire to open her own studio.
Our desires keep changing.

src.t: How do you shortcut that desire contract?

lg: 心里燃起的一股“我想要”。

cards.ex: A contract is an agreement between two sides. A desire contract means: I agree to be unhappy until I get what I want.
exs: I signed a contract with the salon.
Read the contract before you sign it.

src.t: How do you shortcut that desire contract?

lg: 双方说好、签了字的约定。

cards.ex: To focus means to put all your attention on one thing and not get distracted by other things.
exs: I need to focus on one lash style first.
Focus on your client, not your phone.

src.t: You could focus, you could decide that I don’t want most things.

lg: 把所有光线聚到一个点上。

cards.ex: Unnecessary means not needed. You could live without it and nothing bad would happen.
exs: Don't add unnecessary steps.
That stress was totally unnecessary.

src.t: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything,
src.ft: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything, so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.

lg: 多出来的、本可以没有的。

cards.ex: To pick up something can mean to get it without really trying, like a habit, an idea or a desire from the people around you.
exs: Kids pick up bad words at school.
I picked up a few lash tricks from YouTube.

src.t: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything,
src.ft: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything, so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.

lg: 走着走着，顺手就粘上了。

cards.ex: An opinion is what you think or feel about something. It is not a fact, it is your personal view.
exs: In my opinion, natural lashes look better.
Everyone has an opinion about it.

src.t: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything,
src.ft: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything, so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.

lg: 心里对一件事的个人看法。

cards.ex: A judgment is a decision or opinion about whether something or someone is good or bad.
exs: Try not to make quick judgments about people.
Use your own judgment.

src.t: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything,
src.ft: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything, so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.

lg: 在心里给人或事打个“好/坏”的分。

cards.ex: The source is where something comes from, the place it starts.
exs: Stress is the source of many problems.
What's the source of this information?

cards.ex: Unhappiness is the feeling of not being happy. It is the opposite of happiness.
exs: Too many desires can lead to unhappiness.
Her unhappiness showed on her face.

src.t: so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.
src.ft: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything, so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.

cards.ex: Choosy means you are careful about what you pick. You do not say yes to everything.
exs: Be choosy about which clients you take.
She's very choosy about her lash glue.

src.t: so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.
src.ft: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything, so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.

cards.ex: Frankly means honestly and directly. You say it before telling the truth, even if it is not nice.
exs: Frankly, I don't like this style.
Frankly, you need more practice.

src.t: And frankly if you want to be successful, you have to be choosy about your desires, you have to focus.

lg: 不绕弯，直接把真话说出来。

cards.ex: To waste means to use something badly or for nothing, like time, money or energy.
exs: Don't waste your time on people who don't respect you.
I wasted a lot of glue today.

src.t: You can’t be great at everything. You’re just going to waste your energy and waste your time.

lg: 把有用的东西白白扔掉。
